column4: cleat#3729: this engine test opens testutil.TestDB(t, testutil.DialectPostgres) directly, with no t.Run dialect loop, so in a job that configures no PostgreSQL it skips whole under its BARE name. Measured with only CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL set (the other two DSNs unset): env -u CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES -u CLEAT_TEST_DB -u CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL=<dsn> go test ./engine/ -run '^TestAStoreSeesOnlyItsOwnTenantsVersionsEvenThroughARoleThatBypassesRLS$' -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly this one test; with PostgreSQL set it reports none. It FAILS rather than skips when PostgreSQL is configured but its role does not bypass row-level security (t.Fatal).
